facts.fact: The National Retail Federation forecasts US November and December retail sales of $1.013 trillion, up 4.2%.
facts.quote: The National Retail Federation forecasts $1.013 trillion in November and December retail sales, up 4.2%.

facts.fact: Mastercard Economics Institute (SpendingPulse) forecasts US holiday retail sales excluding autos and gas, covering Nov 1 to Dec 24, to rise 5.5%.
Visa Business and Economic Insights forecasts US holiday retail sales for November and December to rise 4.5%.

Circana's Holiday Purchase Intentions Study, based on a survey of 3,534 US consumers, puts fourth-quarter spending between down 1% and up 2.5%, with average planned spend at $779 versus $796 last year.

facts.fact: Bain & Company forecasts about $1,016 billion in US holiday-season spending across in-store and nonstore channels, roughly $695 billion in-store and $321 billion nonstore.
facts.quote: About $1,016 billion forecast (roughly $695 billion in-store, $321 billion nonstore)

facts.fact: EMARKETER's February 2026 forecast puts US holiday retail up about 2.6% and ecommerce up about 6.6%.

facts.fact: The IAB video report puts linear TV at 39% of US TV and video ad spend, with digital video at 61%.
